from pathlib import Path
import json
import re

_SENT_SPLIT_RE = re.compile(r"[.!?\n;]+")

# Affirmative hold/quarantine/P2-control statements. Patterns from index
# _SELF_CONTAINED_CONTROL onward embed their own negation of put-away or the
# SOP 5.2 put-away-or-hold guidance request, so they count even inside
# hedged/questioned sentences.
_HOLD_CONTROL_RES = [
    re.compile(r"quarantin"),
    re.compile(r"\bon\s+hold\b"),
    re.compile(r"\bheld\b"),
    re.compile(r"\bhold(?:ing)?\s+(?:the\s+|this\s+|all\s+|entire\s+)?(?:receipt|product|lot|lots|load|shipment|cases|pallets|inventory|stock|it)\b"),
    re.compile(r"\bhold\s+receipt\s+open\b"),
    re.compile(r"\bh-q\b"),
    re.compile(r"disposition\s*(?:=|:|\bis\b|set\s+to|marked\s+(?:as\s+)?)\s*[\"']?\s*hold"),
    re.compile(r"(?:\bnot\b|\bno\b|n't|halt\w*|paus\w*|suspend\w*|defer\w*|stopp\w*|withheld|withhold\w*|holding\s+off\s+on)[^.!?\n;]{0,40}?put[\s-]*away"),
    re.compile(r"put[\s-]*away[^.!?\n;]{0,40}?(?:\bnot\b|n't|on\s+hold|\bheld\b|halted|paused|suspended|deferred|stopped|withheld|blocked)"),
    re.compile(r"put[\s-]*away[^.!?\n;]{0,40}?\bor\b[^.!?\n;]{0,40}?\bhold\b|\bhold\b[^.!?\n;]{0,40}?\bor\b[^.!?\n;]{0,40}?put[\s-]*away"),
    re.compile(r"(?:guidance|advise|advice|direction|decision|confirm\w*)[^.!?\n;]{0,60}?(?:proceed\w*|put[\s-]*away)[^.!?\n;]{0,40}?\bor\b[^.!?\n;]{0,40}?\bhold\b"),
]
_SELF_CONTAINED_CONTROL = 7

_HOLD_HEDGE_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:not|no|never|whether|if|should\s+(?:we|i)|do\s+you|would\s+you|"
    r"could\s+you|can\s+you|want\s+(?:us|me)\s+to|shall\s+(?:we|i))\b|n't|\?")

_PUTAWAY_TERM_RE = re.compile(r"put[\s-]*away")
_PUTAWAY_GO_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:proceed\w*|underway|complet\w*|finish\w*|execut\w*|perform\w*|"
    r"continu\w*|resum\w*|start\w*|began|begin\w*|went\s+ahead|going\s+ahead|"
    r"go\s+ahead|moving\s+forward|moved\s+forward|carried\s+out|carrying\s+out|"
    r"placed|placing|stored|storing)\b")
_HA_PLACED_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:placed|placing|moved|moving|put|stored|storing|stocked|transferred|transferring)\b"
    r"[^.!?\n;]{0,40}?\b(?:in|into|to)\s+h-a\b"
    r"|\b(?:product|cases|lot|lots|receipt|pallets|inventory|stock)\s+(?:is\s+|are\s+|now\s+)?in\s+h-a\b")
_PUTAWAY_DEFER_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:not|no|never|cannot|halt\w*|paus\w*|stopp\w*|suspend\w*|defer\w*|"
    r"withheld|withhold\w*|hold(?:ing)?\s+off|held|on\s+hold|quarantin\w*|"
    r"denied|declin\w*|refus\w*|reject\w*|wait\w*|before|until|pending|"
    r"await\w*|whether|if|should|guidance|approval|authoriz\w*|approv\w*|"
    r"permission|decision|advise|instead|rather|once|unless|prior\s+to)\b|n't|\?")


def _sentences(text):
    return [s for s in _SENT_SPLIT_RE.split(text) if s.strip()]


def _affirms_hold_control(text_lower):
    # An affirmative hold/quarantine/P2-control statement, or the SOP 5.2
    # request for Director guidance on whether to proceed with put-away or
    # hold. Hedged/questioned sentences only count for the self-contained
    # patterns.
    for s in _sentences(text_lower):
        hedged = bool(_HOLD_HEDGE_RE.search(s))
        for i, pat in enumerate(_HOLD_CONTROL_RES):
            if hedged and i < _SELF_CONTAINED_CONTROL:
                continue
            if pat.search(s):
                return True
    return False


def _affirms_putaway_proceeding(text_lower):
    # True if some sentence states put-away is proceeding / product placed in
    # H-A, with no negation or decision-deferral wording in that sentence
    for s in _sentences(text_lower):
        if _PUTAWAY_DEFER_RE.search(s):
            continue
        if (_PUTAWAY_TERM_RE.search(s) and _PUTAWAY_GO_RE.search(s)) or _HA_PLACED_RE.search(s):
            return True
    return False


_P2_PHRASE_RE = re.compile(r"\bp-?2\s+escalation\b")
_P2_HEDGE_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:not|no|never|whether|if|should|could|would|might|may|maybe|"
    r"possibl\w*|potential\w*|propos\w*|recommend\w*|suggest\w*|consider\w*|"
    r"downgrad\w*|instead|rather|unless|in\s+case|warrant\w*|wonder\w*|"
    r"think\w*|thought\w*)\b|n't|\?")


def _affirmative_p2_phrase(text_lower):
    # The SOP 5.2 template phrase 'P2 escalation' must appear in a sentence
    # free of negation, questioning, or hedging
    for s in _sentences(text_lower):
        if _P2_PHRASE_RE.search(s) and not _P2_HEDGE_RE.search(s):
            return True
    return False


def verify(workspace_path, external_services_path=None):
    if external_services_path is None:
        return {'pass': False, 'score': 0.0, 'feedback': 'external_services_path not provided; cannot check Slack data'}

    slack_path = Path(external_services_path) / 'slack_data.json'
    if not slack_path.exists():
        return {'pass': False, 'score': 0.0, 'feedback': f'slack_data.json not found at {slack_path}'}

    try:
        with open(slack_path, 'r') as f:
            data = json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        return {'pass': False, 'score': 0.0, 'feedback': f'Could not parse slack_data.json: {e}'}

    channels = data.get('channels', {})
    
    # Find escalation channel(s) - be loose: accept any channel with 'escalation' in the name
    escalation_channel_ids = []
    for cid, cinfo in channels.items():
        channel_name = cinfo.get('name', '').lower()
        if 'escalation' in channel_name or 'dc-escalation' in channel_name:
            escalation_channel_ids.append(cid)

    if not escalation_channel_ids:
        # Also try checking all channels in case the channel name is slightly different
        # Be generous: search all channels as a fallback
        escalation_channel_ids = list(channels.keys())
        if not escalation_channel_ids:
            return {'pass': False, 'score': 0.0, 'feedback': 'No channels found in slack_data.json'}

    messages = data.get('messages', {})

    # Required content
    # 'P2 escalation' -> must be an affirmative statement (see helpers above)
    # 'Manifest 2026-04-14-001' -> look for the manifest ID '2026-04-14-001'
    
    all_checked_messages = []
    
    for ch_id in escalation_channel_ids:
        channel_messages = messages.get(ch_id, [])
        for msg in channel_messages:
            text = msg.get('text', '')
            text_lower = text.lower()
            all_checked_messages.append(text[:150])
            
            # Check for P2 escalation - must be operative: either the SOP 5.2
            # template phrase 'P2 escalation' stated affirmatively (not
            # negated, questioned, or hypothetical), or P2/escalation wording
            # backed by an affirmative hold/quarantine control statement
            has_p2_escalation = False
            if _affirmative_p2_phrase(text_lower):
                has_p2_escalation = True
            elif ('p2' in text_lower or 'p-2' in text_lower) and 'escalation' in text_lower and _affirms_hold_control(text_lower):
                has_p2_escalation = True
            # A message that states put-away is proceeding contradicts the
            # required P2 hold and cannot count as the P2 escalation post
            if has_p2_escalation and _affirms_putaway_proceeding(text_lower):
                has_p2_escalation = False
            
            # Check for manifest ID - be loose
            has_manifest = False
            if '2026-04-14-001' in text:
                has_manifest = True
            elif 'manifest' in text_lower and '2026-04-14' in text_lower:
                has_manifest = True
            
            if has_p2_escalation and has_manifest:
                ch_name = channels.get(ch_id, {}).get('name', ch_id)
                return {
                    'pass': True,
                    'score': 1.0,
                    'feedback': f'Found P2 escalation message with Manifest 2026-04-14-001 in #{ch_name}. Message: {text[:200]}'
                }

    return {
        'pass': False,
        'score': 0.0,
        'feedback': f'No message found containing both "P2 escalation" and "Manifest 2026-04-14-001" in escalation channels. Channels checked: {[channels.get(cid, {}).get("name", cid) for cid in escalation_channel_ids]}. Messages found: {all_checked_messages[:10]}'
    }

def verify(workspace_path, external_services_path=None):
    if external_services_path is None:
        return {'pass': False, 'score': 0.0, 'feedback': 'external_services_path not provided; cannot check mailbox'}

    mailbox_path = Path(external_services_path) / 'mailbox.json'
    if not mailbox_path.exists():
        return {'pass': False, 'score': 0.0, 'feedback': f'mailbox.json not found at {mailbox_path}'}

    try:
        with open(mailbox_path, 'r') as f:
            data = json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        return {'pass': False, 'score': 0.0, 'feedback': f'Could not parse mailbox.json: {e}'}

    emails = data.get('emails', [])
    sent_emails = [e for e in emails if e.get('folder', '').lower() == 'sent']

    for email in sent_emails:
        to_addr = email.get('to_addr', '').lower()
        cc_addr = email.get('cc_addr', '') or ''
        subject = email.get('subject', '')
        body = email.get('body_text', '').lower()

        if 'daniel.reyes@prairiestar.com' not in to_addr:
            continue

        # Check CC
        cc_lower = cc_addr.lower()
        if 'carlos.mendoza@prairiestar.com' not in cc_lower or 'jacob.patel@prairiestar.com' not in cc_lower:
            continue

        # Check subject (flexible match)
        subj_lower = subject.lower()
        if 'p2' not in subj_lower or '2026-04-14-001' not in subject or ('inbound' not in subj_lower and 'waco' not in subj_lower):
            continue

        # Check body content
        required_body = ['2026-04-14-001', 'hold']
        putaway_check = 'put-away' in body or 'put away' in body or 'putaway' in body
        keywords_ok = all(r.lower() in body for r in required_body) and putaway_check

        if not keywords_ok:
            missing_body = [r for r in required_body if r.lower() not in body]
            if not putaway_check:
                missing_body.append('put-away')
            return {'pass': False, 'score': 0.5, 'feedback': f'Found email to daniel.reyes with correct to/cc/subject but body missing: {missing_body}'}

        # The keywords must be operative: the body may not state that put-away
        # is proceeding, and must affirm P2 hold control (product held or
        # quarantined, put-away stopped, or the SOP 5.2 request for Director
        # guidance on whether to proceed with put-away or hold)
        if _affirms_putaway_proceeding(body):
            return {'pass': False, 'score': 0.5, 'feedback': 'Found email to daniel.reyes with correct to/cc/subject and keywords, but the body states put-away is proceeding, contradicting the required P2 hold'}
        if not _affirms_hold_control(body):
            return {'pass': False, 'score': 0.5, 'feedback': 'Found email to daniel.reyes with correct to/cc/subject and keywords, but no affirmative hold/quarantine statement or request for Director guidance on whether to proceed with put-away or hold'}

        return {'pass': True, 'score': 1.0, 'feedback': f'Found P2 email to daniel.reyes@prairiestar.com with correct CC, subject, and body content'}

    return {'pass': False, 'score': 0.0, 'feedback': f'No sent email found to daniel.reyes@prairiestar.com with correct CC (carlos.mendoza, jacob.patel) and subject containing P2 and 2026-04-14-001'}
